parakeet: Because the moment you start believing in your own capacity for goodness, you stop needing their gospel. And that's the real danger to them. As long as you're convinced you're broken, then they stay in business. You're not being taught how to live well. You're being taught how to relapse in ways that keep you emotionally hooked. This is why so many believers feel stuck doing things they hate just to feel bad enough to justify coming back to the cross. It's not freedom, it's a treadmill of guilt disguised as redemption.
